verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents an official Snowflake CLI that lets developers create, manage, update, and view apps across Streamlit in Snowflake, Native Apps, Snowpark Container Services, and Snowpark, and a probe confirms the CLI documentation page exists. The evidence is limited to a one-line description of scope and says nothing about how the CLI fits AI-native or agent workflows. Missing for 10: detail on command coverage (e.g., SQL execution, auth, scripting/machine-readable output), anything on AI- or agent-oriented use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
